description: Styling and layout fundamentals: selectors, the cascade, the box model, spacing and typography, colors, display, Flexbox, Grid, and responsive design, ending in a capstone responsive interface.
levelTitle: Level 1: Core Web Standards & Styling Architecture

lessons.title: What Is CSS?
lessons.description: Understand CSS as a rule-based styling language, learn the anatomy of a CSS rule, and build the mental model that styles are matched to elements and then resolved.
lessons.originalIntent: Understand CSS as a rule-based styling language, learn the anatomy of a CSS rule, and build the mental model that styles are matched to elements and then resolved.

lessons.title: Selectors and Specificity
lessons.description: Learn how CSS identifies elements with type, class, ID, attribute, and descendant selectors, then understand why conflicting rules do not all have equal priority.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how CSS identifies elements with type, class, ID, attribute, and descendant selectors, then understand why conflicting rules do not all have equal priority.

lessons.title: The Cascade and Inheritance
lessons.description: Understand how the CSS cascade resolves competing declarations, how inherited properties flow from parent to child, and why !important should not be your first response to a styling conflict.
lessons.originalIntent: Understand how the CSS cascade resolves competing declarations, how inherited properties flow from parent to child, and why !important should not be your first response to a styling conflict.

lessons.title: The CSS Box Model
lessons.description: Understand how every HTML element becomes a box made of content, padding, border, and margin, and learn how the browser calculates the space that element occupies.
lessons.originalIntent: Understand how every HTML element becomes a box made of content, padding, border, and margin, and learn how the browser calculates the space that element occupies.

lessons.title: Spacing, Sizing, and Layout
lessons.description: Turn the box model into practical layout skills by controlling width, height, spacing, and gaps while learning to distinguish element size from the space around it.
lessons.originalIntent: Turn the box model into practical layout skills by controlling width, height, spacing, and gaps while learning to distinguish element size from the space around it.

lessons.title: Typography and Text
lessons.description: Learn how CSS controls typography, including font family, size, weight, line height, alignment, and readable text width.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how CSS controls typography, including font family, size, weight, line height, alignment, and readable text width.

lessons.title: Colors, Backgrounds, and Borders
lessons.description: Learn how CSS controls foreground and background colors, borders, rounded corners, and simple visual surfaces while keeping contrast and content accessibility in mind.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how CSS controls foreground and background colors, borders, rounded corners, and simple visual surfaces while keeping contrast and content accessibility in mind.

lessons.title: Display and Normal Flow
lessons.description: Understand how block and inline elements participate in normal document flow, how the display property changes that behavior, and why layout bugs often begin with misunderstanding the flow.
lessons.originalIntent: Understand how block and inline elements participate in normal document flow, how the display property changes that behavior, and why layout bugs often begin with misunderstanding the flow.

lessons.title: Flexbox Fundamentals
lessons.description: Learn how Flexbox arranges elements along a main axis and cross axis, and use it to build practical one-dimensional layouts with predictable alignment and spacing.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how Flexbox arranges elements along a main axis and cross axis, and use it to build practical one-dimensional layouts with predictable alignment and spacing.

lessons.title: CSS Grid Fundamentals
lessons.description: Learn CSS Grid as a two-dimensional layout system, define rows and columns with tracks, control spacing with gaps, and place content into a predictable grid.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn CSS Grid as a two-dimensional layout system, define rows and columns with tracks, control spacing with gaps, and place content into a predictable grid.

lessons.title: Responsive Design and Media Queries
lessons.description: Learn how responsive layouts adapt to different viewport sizes using flexible sizing, media queries, and mobile-first CSS.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how responsive layouts adapt to different viewport sizes using flexible sizing, media queries, and mobile-first CSS.

lessons.title: CSS Challenge: Build a Responsive Interface
lessons.description: Bring the CSS module together by transforming a structured HTML page into a polished, responsive interface using the cascade, box model, typography, colors, Flexbox, Grid, and responsive design.
lessons.topicTitle: Css Challenge Build A Responsive Interface
lessons.originalIntent: Bring the CSS module together by transforming a structured HTML page into a polished, responsive interface using the cascade, box model, typography, colors, Flexbox, Grid, and responsive design.
